claims.claim_text: We introduce CARLA, an open-source simulator for autonomous driving research.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA is an open-source simulator for autonomous driving research.
claims.source_quote:
We introduce CARLA, an open-source simulator for autonomous driv-
ing research.

claims.claim_text: CARLA has been developed from the ground up to support development, training, and validation of autonomous urban driving systems.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA supports development, training, and validation of autonomous urban driving systems.
claims.source_quote:
CARLA has been developed from the ground up to support devel-
opment, training, and validation of autonomous urban driving systems.

claims.claim_text: CARLA provides open digital assets (urban layouts, buildings, vehicles) that were created for this purpose and can be used freely.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA provides freely usable open digital assets including urban layouts, buildings, and vehicles.
claims.source_quote:
In addition to open-source code and protocols, CARLA provides open digital assets
(urban layouts, buildings, vehicles) that were created for this purpose and can
be used freely.

claims.claim_text: The simulation platform supports flexible specification of sensor suites and environmental conditions.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA supports flexible specification of sensor suites and environmental conditions.
claims.source_quote:
The simulation platform supports ﬂexible speciﬁcation of sensor
suites and environmental conditions.

claims.claim_text: We use CARLA to study the performance of three approaches to autonomous driving: a classic modular pipeline, an end-to-end model trained via imitation learning, and an end-to-end model trained via reinforcement learning.
claims.normalized_text: CARLA is used to study three autonomous driving approaches: classic modular pipeline, end-to-end imitation learning, and end-to-end reinforcement learning.
claims.source_quote:
We use CARLA to study the performance
of three approaches to autonomous driving: a classic modular pipeline, an end-
to-end model trained via imitation learning, and an end-to-end model trained via
reinforcement learning.

claims.claim_text: The approaches are evaluated in controlled scenarios of increasing difficulty, and their performance is examined via metrics provided by CARLA.
claims.normalized_text: The three approaches are evaluated in controlled scenarios of increasing difficulty using CARLA's metrics.
claims.source_quote:
The approaches are evaluated in controlled scenarios of
increasing difﬁculty, and their performance is examined via metrics provided by
CARLA, illustrating the platform’s utility for autonomous driving research.
